grand_strategy.reading:
The Philippines is a small naval power in a contest it cannot win by force and has
chosen not to fight by force. Its answer is two instruments of the weak: exposure
as the weapon (every Chinese act is filmed, dated and protested, so the grey zone
that Beijing chose in order to stay below the level of war becomes a legal and
reputational ledger) and alliance as the shield (a treaty of 1951 read to cover
coast-guard ships, nine sites, missile batteries, and since 2025 a ring of
visiting-forces agreements that makes the shield plural). Luttwak's logic shows
in the price of each. Transparency cannot be switched off for a compromise, so the
2024 understanding at Second Thomas Shoal is disowned at home even as it holds;
and the shield turns the archipelago into a forward base whose missiles, Marcos
admits, would pull the country into a Taiwan war. The alliance is also a bet on
two presidents: Washington's (a 2025 strategy that forgot Manila, a tariff moved
to 12.5% over forced labour) and Manila's own, because the foreign policy
depends on a government whose trust rating is 28-34% against a vice president
at 57-58% whose family prefers accommodation with Beijing. Hence China is graded
rival, not adversary: no side seeks the other's end, Lazaro protests and talks in
the same week, and 28.6% of imports still come from China. Signals that are not
rows: the Philippines' own defence secretary denying an understanding the foreign
ministry announced; and a Code of Conduct that Manila chairs toward and doubts.

stances.note: Rival, not adversary. The test is whether a declared aim is the other's defeat or disappearance, and neither side states one: Manila's aim is to keep what it holds and the award's zone, not to end the Chinese state, and it keeps the channel open while it protests (Lazaro met Wang Yi on 22 Jul 2026, the first foreign-minister bilateral in two years, raised the Ayungin baton incident and reaffirmed the One China policy in the same meeting). Beijing's aim at the shoals is control, removal of the Sierra Madre and, at Scarborough, a 'national nature reserve' (State Council, Sep 2025) - coercion short of war, not Manila's destruction. The friction is the sharpest in the region: Second Thomas Shoal baton assault (20 Jul 2026), water cannon at Scarborough on 23-24 Jul 2026, the Sabina ramming of 31 Aug 2024, a Chinese platform inside the Scarborough lagoon (May-June 2026). The pair is also tied by trade: China supplies 28.6% of Philippine imports. No source uses the word 'rival': the grade is our reading of the structure (confidence C), as for Kosovo toward Serbia. Trend stable: a first ministerial bilateral in two years, but incidents continue. Bond - grievance: the 2016 award that Beijing calls null, and the shoals taken in 2012.

stances.note: Treaty ally under the 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty. The 29 Mar 2025 joint statement of Hegseth and Teodoro says the treaty covers armed attacks on armed forces, aircraft and public vessels, coast guards included, anywhere in the South China Sea; nine EDCA sites, Task Force Philippines and, since 2024, Typhon and NMESIS launchers stay on Philippine soil (a Tomahawk was fired from Tacloban in May 2026). Friction is real and rising: Foreign Policy notes that the 2025 US National Security Strategy omitted the Philippines and that Trump seeks stable ties with Beijing; the 19% tariff of 2025 became 12.5% under Section 301 on 24 Jul 2026. Grade ally, not reluctant ally: Manila asks for more of the alliance, not less. Trend stable: military integration up, trade and strategy cooler. Bond - affinity: colonial history to 1946 and a diaspora that sends 39.7% of cash remittances.

stances_toward.note: Unofficial ties only; the relevant fact is geography. The Bashi Channel and Batanes sit 100 nautical miles from Taiwan, and Marcos has said the Philippines would be 'pulled in' by a war over Taiwan. In Feb 2026 Manila, Washington and Tokyo ran their first Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity over the Bashi Channel (Taiwan not a participant). Reports of Philippine-Taiwanese coast-guard patrols and Taiwanese observers at Kamandag 2025 rest on a single Washington Post account relayed by Taiwan News and are unconfirmed. Earlier: the Sabina ramming of 31 Aug 2024 and the Scarborough nature reserve of 10 Sep 2025. Wang Yi met Lazaro in Manila on 22 Jul 2026, the first ministerial bilateral in two years.
